features.name: Table extensions stored in single SQL table
features.description: In BC29, table extensions are no longer stored in separate tables per app but consolidated into a single SQL table alongside the base table, improving performance and enabling cross-app key support.

features.name: Cross-app keys in table extensions
features.description: BC29 now enables creation of keys that combine standard base table fields with extension fields from different apps, solving a long-standing limitation.

features.name: Load fields for selective field retrieval
features.description: Feature introduced in BC24 (exact version uncertain) allowing developers to specify which fields to load in queries to optimize joins between extension tables.
caveats: Difficult to predict which fields can be safely excluded

features.name: Compact extension table storage
features.description: Storage mechanism introduced around BC24 that consolidates all app extension fields into a single extra table per base table, reducing join complexity from many tables to just two.
caveats: No cross-app key support until BC29
